title: Standalone Excel is the primary workflow
acceptance: Create, save, reopen and recompute a beam without ETABS or an HTTP service.

title: Separate design, check and detailing
acceptance: Check mode preserves supplied bars; design mode returns required steel; neither claims fabricated detail.

title: Expose supported scope before calculation
acceptance: A flexure-only result labels its scope; axial/torsional/deep/flanged branches outside support return unsupported.

title: Provide supplied-actions and loads modes
acceptance: Supplied actions retain case/combination ID, factor state, self-weight inclusion or exclusion, source/origin and either combination constituents or an explicit externally governed combination declaration; report these effective values. Loads mode uses a separately verified bounded solver.

title: Keep concurrent case vectors
acceptance: Moment, shear, torsion and axial actions retain station, combination and sign; component maxima are never invented as one case.

title: Define ULS and SLS bases
acceptance: Factored actions are never factored twice; service actions require service combinations and sustained-load data when used.

title: Define supports and coordinates
acceptance: Clear span, support faces, offsets, restraints, local axes and positive signs are visible and round-trip unchanged.

title: Resolve critical stations
acceptance: Point loads, action extrema, discontinuities and support faces are covered; endpoints plus midpoint alone cannot establish member coverage.

title: Bind engineering rule and data revisions
acceptance: Each run records code edition, amendments, dataset digest and engine version; no silent latest-code substitution.

title: Make dimensions and effective depth explicit
acceptance: Reject nonfinite or impossible geometry; section d is measured from compression face and is less than overall depth.

title: Reconcile depth with selected bars
acceptance: Recompute centroids after bar/layer selection; strength and SLS use the final arrangement or a named provisional result.

title: Record cover convention and durability inputs
acceptance: Cover is explicitly to the defined steel surface; exposure/fire requirements and chosen nominal cover remain traceable.

title: Verify ordinary rectangular flexure
acceptance: Pass/fail and limiting branches replay named source cases with unrounded decisions and metric-specific tolerances.

title: Add compression steel and flanges explicitly
acceptance: Compression-steel stress and flange applicability have separate examples; unsupported branches cannot reuse a rectangular approximation silently.

title: Check and select links
acceptance: Shear resistance, maximum stress, minimum reinforcement, link geometry and spacing are checked for all required stations.

title: Define torsion interaction support
acceptance: Nonzero torsion blocks an ordinary no-torsion profile; enabled torsion checks both equivalent moment and shear with applicability.

title: Distinguish screening from calculated deflection
acceptance: Span-depth screening is labeled screening; a missing detailed deflection check never appears as a detailed SLS pass.

title: Model detailed short and long-term SLS
acceptance: Elastic coefficient/load shape, cracking, creep, shrinkage and sustained history are explicit; reference comparisons match assumptions.

title: Select a declared crack-control route
acceptance: A profile names its deemed-to-satisfy or calculated route; missing inputs yield incomplete scope, not a blank green cell.

title: Verify constructible longitudinal bars
acceptance: Minimum/maximum reinforcement, clear spacing, layers and link enclosure use actual bar positions. Nominal maximum aggregate size is supplied or resolved by a named versioned profile and bound to effective-input identity; missing size leaves constructibility uncovered.

title: Resolve development, anchorage and laps
acceptance: Bar ends and lap locations bind to actual support/member geometry, material basis and applicable restrictions.

title: Verify curtailment and redistribution branches
acceptance: Curtailment uses demand envelopes and anchorage beyond cutoff; redistribution is only enabled with its own eligibility and analysis proof.

title: Keep BBS tied to resolved detail
acceptance: Marks, shapes, bend convention, lengths and quantities derive from one arrangement; unresolved geometry prevents issued BBS.

title: Require a separate seismic profile
acceptance: System, joint, capacity-design and detailing context is required before seismic compliance can be claimed.

title: Gate advanced beam families
acceptance: Deep/continuous-deep, openings, dapped, curved, prestressed and nonprismatic beams each need explicit capability and reference suites.

title: Use one versioned input/result contract
acceptance: C# DTOs, worksheet mapping, documentation and future HTTP projections validate against the same named schema.

title: Classify every optional input
acceptance: Fields are required, conditional, profile-resolved or cosmetic; absence, null and zero have different meanings.

title: Make defaults effective and auditable
acceptance: A named profile resolves engineering defaults before hashing; returned effective inputs show values and origins.

title: Publish example-linked signatures
acceptance: Every public operation lists purpose, input/output types, units, errors, support and at least one worked scenario.

title: Separate status dimensions
acceptance: Execution, engineering outcome, scope completeness and freshness are separate; missing checks cannot collapse to PASS.

title: Bind results to numerical inputs and rules
acceptance: Any changed engineering input or source data digest invalidates the prior result; report styling has a separate identity.

title: Preserve calculation provenance
acceptance: Per-check source/clause/table/case identifiers, applied branch, intermediate quantities and tolerances are recoverable.

title: Separate schema examples from numerical proofs
acceptance: A schema-valid payload is not a passed calculation; expected reference values never become fabricated C# results.

title: Reconcile disagreements before porting
acceptance: Compare sourcebook, library and StructProof by exact revision and assumptions; resolve outcome differences before adopting a formula.

title: Expose usable worksheet inputs
acceptance: Named input tables show units, required fields and permitted choices; errors identify the affected cell/field.

title: Use commands for workflow effects
acceptance: Calculation functions are deterministic; report/file/workbook writes run through explicit application commands.

title: Prove calculation freshness in Excel
acceptance: Editing a dependency, reopening, manual calculation mode and missing add-in cannot leave an apparently current issued result.

title: Handle ranges and batch results consistently
acceptance: Blank/error/text/mixed-unit cells have specified errors; rows retain beam/case identity and partial-batch failures.

title: Deliver an understandable calculation report
acceptance: Report lists effective inputs, assumptions, scope, checks, governing cases, source revisions and drawings; units persist in export.

title: Allow diagnostics but gate issued packages
acceptance: Draft reports can show failed/incomplete results; issued complete-design/BBS exports require current complete passing required checks.

title: Measure kernel and Excel costs separately
acceptance: Benchmark cold/warm calls, allocation, batch sizes and Excel recalculation on a recorded machine; do not promise a language speedup.

title: Qualify runtime and add-in coexistence
acceptance: Pin SDK/runtime/package; prove x64 Excel load, missing-runtime behavior and coexistence with required add-ins.

title: Provide install, help and recovery
acceptance: A clean target machine can install, open the example workbook, find help and recover from a failed run without losing inputs.

title: Version public behavior deliberately
acceptance: Breaking field/name/unit/status/default changes require a contract migration; strict unknown-field rejection is negotiated by schema version.

title: Keep ETABS behind a separate adapter
acceptance: Import binds model/results revision, units, axes, station offsets and case identity; no COM calls enter pure calculation functions.

title: Ship one verified vertical workflow at a time
acceptance: A milestone includes input, calculation, example, result and user output; module count or closed issues do not establish completion.

title: Use failure families to prevent repeat work
acceptance: Every material defect links symptom, root cause, prevention requirement and acceptance evidence; repeated alerts are grouped.

title: Bind assurance to the delivered candidate
acceptance: Installed/benchmark/schema evidence records exact candidate and scope; focused repair checks precede the named cumulative gate.

title: Prove the first loads-to-actions solver
acceptance: Start with one prismatic simply supported span, point loads and full-span UDL; verify reactions/equilibrium/extrema and reject unsupported restraints.

title: Specify numerical decision policy
acceptance: Use binary64, finite inputs, explicit tolerances and unrounded comparisons; formatting never changes the pass/fail decision.

title: Reuse foundations beyond beams
acceptance: Share quantities, materials, code basis, result/issues and provenance; keep slab/column/footing models distinct until their workflows are specified.

title: Preserve existing scope and source permission
acceptance: This proposal neither replaces old phase authority nor reopens granted normalized-IS-data distribution permission; no release follows from research.
